company.name: London Waste Management Limited
company.address: 4 Roundwood Avenue, Stockley Park, London, UB11 1AF
company.licensing: Registered Waste Carrier with the Environment Agency (licence CBDU308350). Verifiable via https://environment.data.gov.uk/public-register/view/search-waste-carriers-brokers

hours.operatingDays: 7 days a week for waste removal
hours.phoneSupport: Mon-Sat 9am-6pm. On Sundays, support is via live chat only (phone lines closed).
hours.arrivalNotice: Team calls with ~20 minutes' notice before arrival on the day of collection

serviceModel.note: IMPORTANT: this is a professional collection service, distinct from council bulky waste collection and household recycling centres. Do not attribute council-specific rules (e.g. 'staff can't enter your home') to this company's service.
serviceModel.vanCapacity: 20 cubic yards, max weight allowance 1 tonne per full van load
serviceModel.customerPresence: Customer does not need to be present at collection if payment has been made in advance; team can access the property to collect items.
serviceModel.insideCollection: Yes - team will come upstairs and remove items from inside the property. Items are assumed not to need dismantling; customers should ensure clear access (e.g. no items blocking the hallway).
serviceModel.prepInstructions: Bag waste where possible for a swifter, cleaner removal.
serviceModel.loadChanges: Items can be added/removed from a booking by phone or live chat. Minimum collection fee of £40 including VAT applies if waste amount changes from what was booked.
paymentMethods: Bank transfer (by prior arrangement, account holders only)
serviceModel.documentation: Customers receive a PDF quote, full receipt, and booking confirmation by email. A Waste Transfer Note is issued after collection and should be kept for at least 2 years.

mattressSpecific.note: Operational mattress rules only. For prices use companyFacts.catalogue.byItemName (filter itemName containing Mattress / Topper).
mattressSpecific.infestationPolicy: If a mattress is infested (e.g. bed bugs), it must be wrapped in plastic and left outside at least 3 days prior to collection. Additional charges may apply. Customer must inform the company prior to booking.

generalFAQ.wasteDestination: Partnered with multiple commercial recycling facilities across London; waste goes to the nearest required facility depending on material/item type to minimize landfill.
generalFAQ.hazardousWaste: Company does not handle hazardous waste directly; refers customers to UK government guidance at https://www.gov.uk/dispose-hazardous-waste
generalFAQ.ukCoverage: Collection services cover all areas across the UK, not just London.
generalFAQ.quotes: Fixed price quotes are provided after inspecting waste/premises where possible; prices may differ from an initial phone/online estimate if actual waste differs from what was described.
generalFAQ.commercialWaste: Offers commercial waste services across all 32 London boroughs with flexible/custom contract schedules.
